notes.title: Painkiller Goes Action-Heavy With New Rogue Angel Game Mode
notes.content:
Separate from the main campaign, 3D Realms developer Anshar Studios is excited to reveal a new roguelike game mode coming to Painkiller called Rogue Angel.

The new game mode is based on the roguelike genre, which means players can try the crucible thrown at them from Painkiller‘s enemy waves and boss fights over and over from the beginning. Following a roguelike genre mantra of ‘no two runs are the same,’ Rogue Angel takes players to a new realm of Purgatory, where a team of three can advance through procedurally generated arenas, collect tarot card boons, find new powerful weapons, pick up helpful items, and ultimately take on epic bosses. 3D Realms has released a new trailer for Rogue Angel, and it can be seen below.

notes.title: Painkiller Preview: Demon Hunting With Friends
notes.content:
If you had asked me about the Painkiller series only a few months ago, I would have been wholly unfamiliar with the property. Yet, thanks to a video put out by Digital Foundry, which highlighted an interesting RTX remix ray-tracing mod for the 2004 boomer shooter, I began my journey with the series, which has inadvertently led me to discover Anshar Studios and 3D Realms’ latest iteration of Painkiller.

Despite my limited hands-on time with Painkiller (2025), which consisted of only two levels, I came away from the experience feeling optimistic about its October release. Unlike its 2004 (and later) release, Painkiller (2025) is a raid-based multiplayer experience that ditches its single-player campaign roots for a game built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5. Now, for purists or those fond of the 2004 game, Painkiller (2025) might sound like too big of a departure from the original. notes.title: Painkiller - Weapons Trailer
notes.content:
👿💥 Welcome to raw, reckless, demon-obliterating firepower! Get ready to dive into a brutal lineup of devastating weaponry, some newly forged, others ripped straight from the old-school playbook.

From flesh-shredding shurikens to limb-launching rockets, this arsenal is built for turning your enemies into gristle & gibs!

[previewyoutube=4dUKtbucEOk;full][previewyoutube=2J41CouSSWU;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]

In Painkiller, you’ll unleash hell with seven destructive weapons, each offering primary and alternative fire modes, elemental effects such as fire, ice, electro, and kinetic, and upgrades of different abilities to provide unique bonus effects:

[list]
[*] Electrodriver: Barrage enemies with rapid-firing shurikens that bounce off hard surfaces.
[*] Stakegun: Hurls high-damage stakes that can impale foes from long-range.
[*] SMG: Unleashes loads of ammo in short, rapid-fire bursts.
[*] Handcannon: Decimate enemies from long range with deadly precision.
[*] Shotgun: Spits destructive pellets at short range that can damage and stagger multiple foes.
[*] Rocket Launcher: Discharges a rocket projectile with a devastating blast radius that can stagger even heavy enemies.
[*] Painkiller: a versatile weapon with a brutal melee attack that hooks onto enemies, shreds them to pieces, and refills your ammo.
[/list]

notes.title: Painkiller is Back!
